summary: Full end-to-end verification of the V3Cube ride lifecycle (OTP security + passenger live flow + receipt/rating). 7/7 backend pytest pass and all frontend selectors/dialog transitions verified by orchestrating a real two-actor flow (passenger via browser UI, driver via API session). Every request item in the review is GREEN.
verified_scenarios: GET /api/rides/{id} as PASSENGER exposes start_otp (4-digit string) — PASS.
GET /api/rides/{id} as assigned DRIVER strips both start_otp and otp fields — PASS.
POST /api/rides/{id}/status {status:'in_progress'} as driver → 400 with FR detail 'Le code OTP du client est requis pour démarrer la course' — PASS (security bypass blocked).
POST /api/phase1/rides/{id}/start-otp/verify with WRONG otp → 400 'Invalid OTP' — PASS.
POST /api/phase1/rides/{id}/start-otp/verify with CORRECT otp → 200 and ride.status becomes 'in_progress' — PASS.

POST /api/rides/{id}/status {status:'completed'} → 200 and fare_breakdown computed with keys {vehicle_label, base_fare, distance_km, distance_charge, time_seconds, time_charge, min_fare, min_adjustment, total, currency=EUR}; total>0 and base_fare>0 for slug 'sb' — PASS.

Passenger /ride/{id} renders DriverEnRouteView (data-testid=driver-enroute-view) with OTP pill (enroute-otp = 'Code départ <4 digits>'), enroute-call/chat/share/cancel buttons, enroute-driver-name — PASS.
While passenger UI is open, driver→arriving triggers status-dialog with text 'Le chauffeur est arrivé.' (≤7s polling fallback) — PASS.
OTP-verified start triggers status-dialog 'Votre voyage a commencé.' and header switches to 'EN ROUTE' with red enroute-sos-btn — PASS.
driver→completed triggers status-dialog 'Votre voyage est terminé.' and after clicking status-dialog-ok the passenger lands on /ride/{id}/receipt — PASS.

Receipt page (data-testid=ride-receipt-page) shows receipt-total, receipt-charges with labels Tarif de base / Distance / Temps / Total, and receipt-rating block with star-1..star-5, favorite-toggle, rating-comment, skip-rating-btn, submit-rating-btn — PASS.
Submitting rating (5★ + favorite + comment) navigates to /home and shows 'Merci pour votre évaluation !' toast — PASS.
action_items: Minor robustness (non-blocking): if a ride is created with an unknown vehicle_type slug (e.g. 'economy', which is NOT in /api/config/vehicle-types — valid slugs are sb/confort/luxe/moto/pool/suv/...), the fare_breakdown falls back to zeros (vtype={}); estimated_fare at creation also depends on calculate_fare's default. Consider rejecting unknown slugs at POST /api/rides creation, or fall back to the stored ride.base_fare/price_per_km consistently across estimate AND completion.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rides.py:316-318 correctly strips start_otp/otp ONLY when 'is_assigned_driver and not is_admin'. Good — admins still see it (per requirement, admin can relay it). Confirmed by passenger seeing OTP and driver not seeing it.
routes/rides.py:422 (in_progress block for driver) returns French detail — matches UI expectation. Admins/dispatchers can still force-start (intentional).
phase1.verify_start_otp also gates status transitions ('accepted' or 'arriving' only) — good defense in depth.

RideTrackingPage.js uses a 5s polling fallback when WebSocket is down (preview env). End-to-end transitions arrived within ~5-6s as documented; this works but a smaller poll interval during the active ride could feel snappier (acceptable trade-off).

Receipt fare_breakdown total falls to 0 when vehicle_type slug is not registered. Pydantic-level validation on RideRequest.vehicle_type against the active vehicle_types collection would fail-fast and prevent zero-value receipts.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 rides during this run: one via pytest (full lifecycle pending→accepted→arriving→in_progress→completed) and one via UI orchestration (rated 5★ with favorite + comment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP & lifecycle are stable. For future runs orchestrate driver via API session (requests.Session() POST /api/auth/login then POST /api/rides/{id}/accept, /status, /phase1/.../start-otp/verify) and drive the passenger only in the browser. Use vehicle_type='sb' (or any slug returned by GET /api/config/vehicle-types) to get a real fare_breakdown — 'economy' yields zero values. Status transitions appear in the passenger UI within ~5-7s via polling when WS is down. The receipt route is /ride/:rideId/receipt (NOT /receipt/:rideId).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs — all six review items verified. The only non-blocking finding is that an invalid vehicle_type slug at ride creation produces a zero fare_breakdown on completion (cosmetic, not a correctness bug). Add an enum/db validation on RideRequest.vehicle_type to fail fast.
